The publisher has approved 'Glass River' as the replacement closing song. However, the license for 'Glass River' prohibits audience recording of the performance, which directly conflicts with the audience recording permission in our current production draft. I'm also still waiting for the countersigned license scan before I can attach it to the show file, so we don't have the fully executed license in hand yet.
